name: Pundi AI uninitialized swap proxy takeover
summary: Pundi AI deployed its swap proxy with empty initialization data, leaving initialize(address,address) callable by anyone. Twelve seconds later the attacker initialized the proxy, became its owner, and used the original UUPS implementation to install attacker code. That retained authority later minted one million unbacked PUNDIAI.
notes: The proxy creation transaction selected implementation 0xd1393ea0d5f0641274e0084302cea3884b356069 but supplied empty initialization data. Its public initializer remained reachable until the attacker called it in the next block.

Ethereum token-transfer receipts reconstruct 22.550224439317992269 WETH and 23,427.2875 USDT received from monetization, less 10 USDT supplied by the attacker in the same campaign. The resulting $90,467.78 is an exact Ethereum-only loss; it excludes recovered or locked tokens and additional BSC proceeds from the official approximately $260,000 cross-chain total.
The exact loss covers Ethereum-realized proceeds only; the official post-mortem's approximately $260,000 cross-chain total also includes BSC proceeds.
